command: kubectl -n invoicing-e40e get deployment taxcalc -o yaml

cat > /tmp/taxcalc-v2-fixed.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: taxcalc
  labels:
    app: taxcalc
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: taxcalc
      track: stable
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: taxcalc
        track: stable
    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 2
      containers:
      - name: taxcalc
        image: busybox:1.36
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        command:
        - sh
        - -c
        - sleep 6; touch /tmp/ready; exec httpd -f -p 8080
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8080
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 10m
            memory: 16Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 64Mi
        env:
        - name: VERSION
          value: '2'
        readinessProbe:
          exec:
            command:
            - test
            - -f
            - /tmp/ready
          periodSeconds: 1
          failureThreshold: 1
EOF
